name_input: Export Promotion Council For Medical Devices
legal_name: Export Promotion Council for Medical Devices (EPCMD-India) — legal form not confirmed from MCA; self-described as a council established 2023 under the aegis of the Department of Pharmaceuticals / Department of Commerce, GoI, with YEIDA (UP)
state_registered: Uttar Pradesh (registered/operating office: YEIDA, 2nd Floor, Commercial Complex, P-2 Sector, Omega I, Greater Noida, Distt. Gautam Budh Nagar, UP - 201310)
note: Entity EXISTS and is active as an organisation: official site epcmd.in confirms 'Export Promotion Council for Medical Devices, EPCMD-India, established in the year 2023 under the umbrella of the Department of Pharmaceuticals, with the facilitation of the Department of Commerce, Government of India, and YEIDA, Government of Uttar Pradesh', with a Greater Noida (UP) office, named officers (CFO Saleem Ahmed, membership/regulatory staff) and an active membership/RCMC scheme. NOT rejected — no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy. HOWEVER: this is an export promotion council / industry body, NOT a manufacturer or trader of goods. It does not produce or sell medical devices; it facilitates exports for its member manufacturers. Role therefore recorded as service_provider. The declared HS code 300420 (medicaments) is inconsistent both with the entity's nature and with its sector (medical devices, not pharma bulk chemicals); per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground — the entity stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual activity (council = no goods HS; if a code must be carried, it should reflect medical devices, e.g. Ch. 9018/9019, not 300420). The claimed industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is also wrong — actual sector is medical devices / export promotion services. Registry identifiers NOT verified: CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, exact incorporation date and MCA status could not be obtained — Zauba Corp, TheCompanyCheck and InstaFinancials all returned HTTP 403, DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused), and Bing/Google returned irrelevant or rate-limited results. No audited accounts or official filings were located, so revenue FY25 and FY26 are null (not estimated). Because it is a council/section-8-type body, revenue figures would in any case not be comparable to trading turnover. Recommendation: treat as a non-supplier / institutional contact, not as a procurement source for goods.
